g.text: TTN: morphing optimized seed 1 toward optimized seed 2
Letters show the actual ALT at each position.
The 17 positions where the endpoints differ
GRCh37 chromosome 2 · 1-based positions · columns in genomic order, not to scale
At 25%, five columns have switched to the target allele. At 100%, all seventeen have switched.
The other 35 positions are unchanged and omitted here; each score includes all 52 positions (67 ALT copies).
One run per amount, each from a fresh origin copy. Fixed ordering seed: 20260912. Equal scores do not establish equal function.
